book.name: EPHESIANS
book.title: Paul EPHESUS ep Tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amumi Pēniata

content: Nu’ Paul, God tunatyayat ahpiy Jesus Christ lavay’ayaat it penta. Nu Ephesus ep God sinomuyatuy, Jesus Christ aw tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy öqalanta.
Nam núokwa, pu kwakwha unaṅwa God Itanay aṅqw umumi pitsíwtaa, pu Itahtutuyqawhqay Jesus Christ aṅq’ö.
Spiritual Blessings in Christ
Nam God Itahtutuyqawhqay Jesus Christ Naat tayawintiwaa. Kwakwhat pi pam Hikwsit kuwahtipuyat ōṅaqwnihqat sohsok itamumi noa, Christ aṅ’a.
Ura pam nāt tūwaqatsit qa yúkuhqe, pay pepeq itamumi unaṅway’taqe, Christ aṅ itamuy namorsta, itam súank̇ahk̇aṅw, qahováriwk̇ahk̇aṅw, put atpip hoṅniqat ōviy’o.
Pam Jesus Christ aṅ itamuy tíoyniqey tunatyawtaqe, ōviy aṅwu pay itamuy namorsta.
Nihqe Tiy pas aw unaṅway’taqey aṅ pam itamuy pās oya, núokway qaöwíhintaqat ahpiy’o, itam put pas hihtatotaniqat ōviy’o.
Pu itam hapi Tiyat uṅwáyat ahpiy qenivo oyiwyuṅwa, God qaan’ewakw núokway ahpiy itahqaanhtipuy ayo yúkuq’ö,
Qaöwíhink̇aṅw itamuy ōkwatuwhqee.
Pi pam sohsok hihta suan wuwni’k̇aṅw, suyan mātsi’k̇aṅw, put tunatyay as tupkiwtaṅwuqat itamumi mātakna. Kurs pam yan hapi nahpe tunatyawta:
Ason tuwanit pās aw pituqw, pep pu’ sohsok hihta nāmi tsovalaniqeyu, ōveqatsit epyaqata, pu tūwaqatsit epyaqata; nit sohsok hihta Christ aw nóani.
God hapi hin tunatyawtaqey pan yúkuṅwu. Noqw pam hapi tunatyay ahpiy Christ aṅ itamuy aṅwu pay namorstaqe, put enaṅ sun itamuy hihta huytaṅwu,
Itam mohti Christ aw taqa’naṅwtotiqamuyu, itam put pas hihtatotaniqat ōviy’o, pam pas hímunihqat ep’e.

Noqw uma lomatuawit qaatsatnihqat nanaptaqe, nuhtum Christ aw taqa’naṅwtoti, it lomatuawit hakiy hin ayo yámakniqat umuy āawnaqata. Uma put aw tūtuptsiwaqw, pahsat pu God Qahováriwtaqat Hikwsit akw umuy tuvoylata; pi put hapi awinit pam sinmuy āawna.
God itamuy hin āawnaqey aw antsanniqey itamumi mahtakna, Hikwsiy itamumi nóahqee, hisat nāp himuy ahoy pas nāptiniqey pahsavoo. Noqw ōviy itam put pas hímunihqat ep put pas hihtatotani.
Paul’s Prayer
Yaw uma Itahtutuyqawhqay Jesus Christ qapēvewnayak̇ahk̇aṅw, God sinomuyatuy sohsokmuy amumi unaṅway’yuṅwa.
Noqw nu it navotqe, ōviy umuhpe God aw hahlayhtima; nihqe inawakinpiy aṅ umuy túṅwanma, qa qe’iwmak̇aṅwo.

Okiw as God Itahtutuyqawhqay Naat pas lolmat tālawṅway’taqa Hikwsiy aṅ umuy unaṅwtalawnaniqat nu umuṅem nāwakinma. Okiw as pam umuy suan wuwnitoyne’, pam hak hímunihqey umumi namtaknani, uma put pās tuwi’vayaniqat ōviy’o.
Pam umuhwuwniy tālawne’, pam it ṅȫyit aw umuy wáṅwayhqey umuy māmatsnani. Itam put sinomat Christ amum hihta pas hihk̇ay’taqat makiwyaniqey aw wáṅwayniwya.
God öqalay pas qaöwíhintaqat itamuy tuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amuhpa’ tumalay’taqey umuy māmatsnani.
Ura pam öqalay akw Christ eṅem a’nö tumaltaqe, mokiwuy aṅqw ahoy put tātayna; nihqe ōveqatsit ep pas nāp putvaqe put qenitoya;

Nihqe sohsokmuy momṅwituy amumi put moṅwtavi, pu nuhtumi tutuyqawhqayamuy amumii, pu öqalat pasiwyuṅqamuyu, pu aṅ tūayalalwaqamuyu. Panta. Noqw ōviy Christ hapi sohsokmuy amuhpenihqe pas pavan k̇aptsi’tiwa, yep qatsit epyaqamuy amuhpenihqee, pu qatsit nātoniqat epyaqamuy amuhpenihqe pīwu.
Noqw sohsoy hihtu put aw maqaptsi’yuṅwni. Noqw ōviy pam God aw tōnawtaqamuy amumi moṅwtaviwa, sohsok hihta aṅ’a.
Pi itam put aw tōnawtaqam put tokoyat anyuṅwa; nihqe sumiyank̇aṅw put ahpiy pasiwyuṅwa, ispi pam hapi sohsok hihta pasiwnaṅwuniq’ö.
